title: fix(cli,mcp): name the MCP server objectstack in os dev's banner, from the constant the served SKILL.md reads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDWJsBGQpadCH8JR2xZQ5re)_

Part of #25341 (the `domain:cli` half: the boot banner and the served SKILL.md). The console's Connect an Agent snippets are objectstack-ai/objectui#13357; this PR leaves that half alone.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The maintainer's ruling (hotcrm#2194 T2-U22, ruling record `6354968262`) says to use one server name in both places. This PR uses the platform constant **`objectstack`**:

- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` exports `OBJECTSTACK_MCP_SERVER_NAME = 'objectstack'`, re-exported from `@objectstack/mcp`. The served SKILL.md's `claude mcp add --transport http NAME URL` now reads it.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`: `printMcpConnectHint` reads the same constant and drops its `name` option. The call site no longer passes `path.basename(process.cwd()) || 'objectstack'`, which is where `hotcrm` came from.

## Why this name and not the app's declared name

The issue allowed either the app's name or the deployment's. Today no producer reads a declared app name:

- The banner used the **folder** name.
- The skill route (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) calls `renderSkill({ mcpUrl })` and has no app identity in reach. The skill is generic across every app a key can reach (ADR-0036 Amendment C).
- objectui#13357 records that discovery serves no server name for the console to read.

Using the app's name would need a new served field in both the skill route and discovery. That is a contract addition, out of scope for an S card. The console snippets already say `objectstack`, so with this PR all three surfaces agree, and objectui#13357 has nothing to change.

## Pins

- `packages/cli/src/commands/dev-mcp-connect-hint-origin.test.ts`, new block "the Connect row names the server the way the served SKILL.md does":
  - drives both producers (`printMcpConnectHint` and `renderSkillMarkdown`) and asserts that each `claude mcp add` names `OBJECTSTACK_MCP_SERVER_NAME`;
  - a source pin asserts that dev.ts imports the constant and has no `basename(process.cwd())`.
  - The existing Connect-row expectations now read `objectstack`.
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts`: the skill's connect command names the exported constant.

## Verification (head `ed39dfa362`)

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `@objectstack/mcp`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` passed (42 files, 533 tests). Its typecheck is green.
- `@objectstack/cli`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, then `vitest run --project unit` passed (326 files, 4804 tests). Its typecheck is green.
- The integration layer is left to CI. No integration-tier or spawn-entry file changed.
- `pnpm lint`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 67 derived, 65 run with exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The two NOT MEASURED gates:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`
  - `check:i18n-coverage`

  Both exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need packages outside this closure built, and this local run did not build them. CI runs both on a fresh build.

## Acceptance notes

- Docs examples (`content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, the blog post) name the server `my-app` / `support-desk`. In a user-typed command that name is the user's own choice, so this PR leaves them as they are.
- `MCPServerRuntime`'s default handshake name (`mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `name: 'objectstack'`) is a separate literal with the same value, outside this card's file surface.
- If you registered the server under the folder name from an earlier banner, that entry keeps working. The changeset gives the one-line cleanup.
